references.text: Moses explains that God tested Israel to teach them obedience, reflecting the theme of learning through experience
God did not lead Israel by the shortest route because they were not ready for war, showing that they had to learn warfare over time
A warning that the remaining nations would become a snare to Israel, connecting to why these nations were left behind
God explains that he allowed the nations to remain in order to test Israel, providing direct context for this verse
The introduction to the list of nations left behind to test Israel, offering immediate context
The purpose of the testing was to see whether Israel would keep the Lord's commands, expanding on the theme
